name: Corinth (United States)
description: White field charged with a stylised Corinthian column in blue and red above the words CORINTH TEXAS.
history: Corinth is a city in Denton County, Texas. Flags of the World records an earlier flag with a red map of Texas and a swooping C, and notes that in 2010 the city had reported having no flag.

features.role: stylised Corinthian column and the name CORINTH
red stripes of the column and the word TEXAS
